lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used cars. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: You narrate a standalone comedy episode: Gena chooses his first car, but his family group chat keeps arguing. Deadpan, dry irony; numbers said fully. «Перехват» is the name of a bot.

gena.profile: Gena — a kind, tired, slightly nerdy Russian guy of 32 with glasses, choosing his first car while his relatives argue; soft voice that slowly gets decisive.
gena.notes: Line 1: tired, to the documentary camera, ironic complaint. Line 2: short, decisive. Line 3: shocked, disbelieving. Line 4: one word, excited, decisive. Line 5: calm, satisfied, final.

palych.profile: Palych — Gena's father-in-law, a grumpy Russian pensioner in his 60s in an ushanka, old-school, believes only in Japanese cars; hoarse, bossy, then unexpectedly warm.
palych.notes: Line 1: bossy, categorical. Line 2: outraged, shocked; the first word «Нива» is said very clearly, «НИ-ва». Line 3: suddenly soft, a bit embarrassed, friendly request.

borya.profile: Uncle Borya — a loud, boastful Russian man in his 50s with a gold chain and a cap, loves Mercedes, a bit of a hustler.
borya.notes: Line 1: loud, offended, proud. Line 2: caught, sheepish but sly, trying to sell. Line 3: disappointed, whiny.

vovan.profile: Vovan — Gena's young brother-in-law of about 25, cheerful, cheeky, loves Lada.
vovan.notes: Line 1: cheerful, fast. Line 2: triumphant, gloating.

semen.profile: Semyonych — a calm, sly Russian pigeon keeper in his 60s in a striped vest, warm hoarse voice, dry humor.
semen.notes: One line: calm and kind; the last sentence is a deadpan joke about pigeons, said slowly.
